entries.title: Death at home
entries.summary: When a loved one passes at home, call us. We arrange the transport, the dignified preparation and the service that fits your family.

gallery.caption: Caring coordination when it happens at home.

entries.title: Death at hospital
entries.summary: When a loved one passes in hospital, we liaise with the facility, handle the transfer and preparation, and coordinate with the venue.

gallery.caption: Liaising with facilities, so you can focus on family.

entries.title: Transport
entries.summary: Dignified transport from home or hospital to the service venue, and onward when the time comes. Our team coordinates it for you.
